generator_cmd: .venv/bin/python -c "import sys; from Bio.Data.CodonTable import standard_dna_table as T; print(\"\".join(T.back_table.get(c.upper(), c) for c in sys.argv[1]))" "$plain"  # Biopython standard_dna_table.back_table (one codon per amino-acid letter), others pass through
oracle_cmd: printf %s "$encoded" | .venv/bin/python -c "import sys, re; from Bio.Seq import Seq; print(re.sub(\"[ACGT]+\", lambda g: str(Seq(g.group()).translate()), sys.stdin.read()).lower())"  # Biopython Seq.translate (standard genetic code) per base run, lower-cased
note: decode-only check: back_table's codon choice may differ from codon_enc's first-codon pick; any synonymous codon decodes
